Emily C: @oncall-bot ACME (tenant acme-42) reporting a p99 latency spike and intermittent 502s starting ~09:15 UTC. Baseline p99 ~450ms, now hitting ~2.4s. Route: /v1/generate, model pinned: redwood-xl-8k-q4. Request ids: r_7f3a, r_7f3b. Can someone triage?
Diego M: on it. Can you paste a sample request id and the tenant id (already have acme-42), also the sequence length distribution if available?
Emily C: sample: r_7f3a. seq lens: lots of short + a tail of 6% >4k tokens. load pattern: bursty at ~12 concurrency.
oncall-bot: Incident SVC-992 created; paging oncall.
Jordan P: quick glance at metrics: kernel logs show repeated slab_compact cycles and partial OOM evictions on worker gpu-12. KV cache for acme-42 grew from 850MB -> 3.6GB over 20m before evictions started. p95/P99 track with KV growth timeline.
Emily C: logs snippet from gpu-12 at 09:18:
```
[09:17:42] kv_cache: tenant=acme-42 size=870MB
[09:18:11] kv_cache: tenant=acme-42 size=2.1GB
[09:19:03] slab_compact: reclaimed=0.4GB latency=130ms
[09:19:10] oom_eviction: tenant=acme-42 freed=1.2GB
[09:20:02] serve_req r_7f3a latency=2400ms status=200
```
Diego M: that looks like fragmentation + KV growth. Two parallel mitigation paths: 1) immediate mitigation to relieve GPU memory pressure (evict KV, reduce per-tenant cap, enable aggressive slab compaction), 2) medium-term: allocator tuning / KV caps and batching limits.
Sara L: I'll push an emergency config: set tenant_kv_soft_cap=1GB for acme-42 and enable aggressive_eviction=true for that tenant. Rolling to cluster gpu-pool-6. Will monitor.
Diego M: also start a traffic-split to route acme-42 requests to fallback model redwood-large-4k (lower KV working set) while we stabilize. Command: `./ops/routing/traffic-shift --tenant acme-42 --to redwood-large-4k --percent 100 --reason "emergency p99 mitigation"`
Emily C: repro steps for SRE runbook: use load script `scripts/acme-repro.sh` with flags `--concurrency 12 --duration 10m --seed 42`. Example: `./scripts/acme-repro.sh --tenant acme-42 --concurrency 12 --prompt-length 3500`
Jordan P: also capture `nvidia-smi` + allocator stats on the worker while running repro. Example: `watch -n1 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,name --format=csv,noheader; cat /var/log/runtime/allocator_stats.log | tail -n 40'`
Emily C: performed the emergency config. Sara: can you confirm rollout id?
Sara L: rollout id cfg-20260317-09:21. Applied to gpu-pool-6 and routing rule created. Monitoring dashboards: p99 for acme-42 dropped from 2.4s -> ~560ms within 90s. Still saw a couple 1.2s tails.
Diego M: good. Next: propose allocator tweak to reduce per-slab fragmentation. Jordan, can you run a controlled experiment on staging: adjust slab_target_fill to 0.65 and enable kv_reclaim_ahead=true, compare p99 under same load? Put results in /eng-runtime/allocator-experiments/PR-482.
Jordan P: yes, I'll run that now on staging-5. Expected changes: fewer compactions, more predictable GC pauses. Will log metrics: slab_fragmentation_ratio, kv_eviction_rate, p50/p95/p99.
Emily C: customer updated support ticket: "we saw immediate improvement after your patch, thanks. Please advise on long-term fix."
Diego M: long-term actions (tracked in ticket): 1) RFC for per-tenant adaptive KV caps + eviction policy (owner: Jordan), 2) runtime allocator tuning release (owner: Diego), 3) improved autoscaling of KV offload to host memory for large-tenants (owner: Platform Eng).
Sara L: note: forced eviction freed ~1.5GB on gpu-12. No crashes observed after intervention.
Jordan P: staging experiment results (initial): slab_target_fill=0.65 reduced fragmentation ratio 0.38 -> 0.22, kv_eviction_rate decreased by 40%, p99 under synthetic burst dropped from 1.9s -> 620ms. I'll open PR with the tuning and a set of guardrails.
Emily C: marking this thread resolved for on-call; I'll follow up with the customer summary and link to runbook changes. closing note: re-run heatmap on tenant map to identify other tenants with similar KV growth patterns. :white_check_mark: 
support-bot: Incident SVC-992 status updated -> mitigated.
Emily C: final: p99 stable ~420ms at 09:59 UTC after routing + eviction + config. Will schedule postmortem if recurrence. :tada:
